theorem erdos_478 :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun p : ℕ =>
        (((Finset.Ico 1 p).image (fun k => Nat.factorial k % p)).card : ℝ) / p)
      (Filter.atTop ⊓ Filter.principal {p : ℕ | p.Prime})
      (nhds (1 - 1 / Real.exp 1))
doc: Let $p$ be a prime and $$A_p = \{ k! \pmod{p} : 1\leq k<p\}.$$ Is it true that $$\lvert A_p\rvert \sim (1-\tfrac{1}{e})p?$$
